name: @palladin/browser-extension
description: Palladin browser extension - user autofill and encrypted Vault access (Manifest V3).

scripts.build:all: npm run check:icons && npm run typecheck && node scripts/run-vite-target.mjs build all
scripts.build:chromium: npm run check:icons && npm run typecheck && node scripts/run-vite-target.mjs build chromium
scripts.build:firefox: npm run check:icons && npm run typecheck && node scripts/run-vite-target.mjs build firefox
scripts.build:safari: npm run check:icons && npm run typecheck && node scripts/run-vite-target.mjs build safari
scripts.test: npm run check:docs && npm run check:icons && vitest run
